pages.text: Every field ends the same way. The $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$() takes whole stacks of everything it produced and compresses them into a $(item)Singularity$().
One for each field: $(li)mathematics$(li)the Standard Model$(li)spacetime$(li)stars$(li)dimensions$(li)time$(li)quantum$(li)cognition$(li)exotic matter

Four singularities plus the field capstones make the $(item)Theory of Everything$() - the unified theory physicists have chased for a century, sitting on my bench. That, the other five singularities, Absolute Infinity and the Omega Point fuse into the $(item)Omniscience Catalyst$().
The catalyst and stacks of every late-game metal make the $(item)Omnium Ingot$() - and the $(item)Omnilex$() is forged from four of them. It costs everything, but nothing here waits on a timer.
Every number, function, proof and infinity, compressed into one point.$(br2)Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().
All nine singularities, fused. Holding it, you know everything - briefly.$(br2)Made in $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().
A metal made of every concept there is. The last ingot.$(br2)Made in a crafting grid.
A singularity of something from another mod (or added by your pack).$(br2)
Quantum fields, gravity, strings and the Standard Model in one equation. It fits on a T-shirt.$(br2)Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().

$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Mathematics Singularity$(): Absolute Infinity, Absolute Singularity, Omniscience Catalyst, Ontological Junction, Spacetime Bearing$(li)$(item)Omniscience Catalyst$(): Omnium Ingot, Pleroma Confluence$(li)$(item)Omnium Ingot$(): Absolute Frame Casing, Apeiron Ingot, Axiom Key, Block of Omnium, Omnilex and more$(li)$(item)Theory of Everything$(): Absolute Notes II, Cosmic Flux Coupler, Omniscience Catalyst
